Package org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.logicprogrammer

Class ExpressionStartPanel

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.logicprogrammer.ExpressionStartPanel
public class ExpressionStartPanel extends Object
The expression panel while no operator is active. It looks like the panel of an expression without parameters.
